*---------------------------------------------------------------*
      *  Date Processing                            Program: UTCSDC00 *
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       01  UTCSDC00-DATA.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
           05  GREGORIAN-DATE         PIC  9(008).
           05  GREGORIAN-DATE-RD      REDEFINES GREGORIAN-DATE.
               10  MM                 PIC  9(002).
                   88  VALID-MONTH         VALUE 01 THRU 12.
               10  DD                 PIC  9(002).
               10  CCYY               PIC  9(004).
                   88  VALID-YEAR          VALUE 1901 THRU 2099.
               10  CCYY-RD            REDEFINES CCYY.
                   15  CC             PIC  9(002).
                       88  21ST            VALUE 20.
                       88  20TH            VALUE 19.
                   15  YY             PIC  9(002).

           05  JULIAN-DATE            PIC S9(005).
               88  VALID-JULIAN-DATE       VALUE 00001 THRU 72684.
               88  20TH-CENT               VALUE 00001 THRU 36159.
               88  21ST-CENT               VALUE 36160 THRU 72684.
           05  JULIAN-DATE-RD         REDEFINES JULIAN-DATE
                                      PIC  X(005).

           05  ALPHA-DATA.
               10  ALPH-MMDDYY        PIC  X(030).
               10  ALPH-DATE          PIC  X(030).
               10  MM-ALPH-LC         PIC  X(010).
               10  MM-ALPH-UC         PIC  X(010).
               10  MM-ABBR-LC         PIC  X(005).
               10  MM-ABBR-UC         PIC  X(004).
               10  DD-ALPH-LC         PIC  X(010).
               10  DD-ALPH-UC         PIC  X(010).
               10  DD-ABBR-LC         PIC  X(005).
               10  DD-ABBR-UC         PIC  X(003).

           05  NUMERIC-DATA.
               10  DD-NUMBER          PIC  9(001).
               10  DD-OCCURANCE       PIC  9(001).
               10  WEEK-NUMBER        PIC  9(002).
               10  DAY-OF-YR          PIC  9(003).
               10  DAYS-LEFT          PIC  9(003).

           05  DATE-FLAG              PIC  X(003).
               88  RETRIEVE-DATE           VALUE "RD ".
               88  GREGORIAN-JULIAN        VALUE "GJ ".
               88  JULIAN-GREGORIAN        VALUE "JG ".
               88  AGE-CURRENT             VALUE "AC ".
               88  AGE-DATE                VALUE "AD " "AC".
               88  GOOD-DATE               VALUE "YES".
               88  BAD-DATE                VALUE "NO ".
               88  VALID-REQUEST           VALUE "RD " "GJ " "JG "
                                                 "AD ".

           05  RETURN-DATE-FORMAT     PIC  9(001).
               88  RETURN-6-DIGIT          VALUE 6.
               88  RETURN-8-DIGIT          VALUE 8.
